newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Cathay carries 18.5 pct more cargo in Jan.
newsitem.headline: Cathay carries 18.5 pct more cargo in Jan.

text.p: Cathay Pacific Airways Limited carried 18.5 percent more cargo during January compared with the same month in 1996, according to airline statistics.
Cathay's cargo load factor rose 7.2 percent, although industry observers said an increase was expected as January 1996 was the start of a memorably bad first half of the year for all cargo carriers.

The amount of freight Cathay carried during January was 45,421 tonnes compared with 38,337 tonnes the previous January. The available tonnes kilometres total rose 10.3 percent from 766,164 in January 1996 to 844,757 this January.
Cathay also reported carrying 2.2 percent more passengers during the month totalling 888,784 along with a 2.8 percent increase in passenger load factor.
